title: Senior Analyst International Accountability Platform for Belarus
description:
Are you an experienced international justice analyst motivated by the opportunity to turn complex information and evidence of violations of international law in Belarus into meaningful action for accountability?

Then DIGNITY can offer you an exciting opportunity as Senior Analyst of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB). Join a highly committed international team and play a meaningful role in advancing international justice and accountability. You will enjoy genuine responsibility, be able to shape impactful work, and be part of a supportive, collaborative culture—whether working remotely or from the office.

The IAPB was created in March 2021 as a consortium of Belarusian and international human rights organisations who joined forces to collect, verify, preserve and analyse evidence of violations of international criminal law and international human rights law allegedly committed by Belarusian authorities since 2020. To this end, the platform directly supports national criminal justice authorities and international accountability mechanisms by providing information and evidence. The IAPB’s objective is to achieve accountability of perpetrators and enable redress for the victims. Its operations were recently extended until end of September 2029.

DIGNITY, as the lead organisation of the consortium, hosts the IAPB’s Secretariat within which the position is located.

Since 1982, DIGNITY has worked for a world free of torture and violence. We are a human rights and development organisation that also runs a rehabilitation clinic in Denmark. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims, and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be held accountable.


About the position

As Senior Analyst your focus will be to ensure that evidence is gathered in line with international standards; that timely and high-quality responses to requests by national and international accountability mechanisms are drafted, involving structuring, drafting and reviewing of submissions and analytical briefs; and that the work of the IAPB’s analysts and open-source researchers is well coordinated.

Your primary tasks are:

  • Overseeing the consolidation and analysis of information and evidence gathered by IAPB’s partners and the secretariat team;
  • Strategic planning as well as overseeing the IAPB’s analytical work to support criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies, in close coordination with the Senior Legal Consultant;
  • Drafting, reviewing and editing of analytical briefs and legal memos for submission to criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies;
  • Supervising and coordinating the work conducted by analysts and consultants, including setting priorities/tasks and ensuring high standards of work, in close coordination with the Legal Advisor.
  • Cooperating with prosecution authorities and international mechanisms.
  • Other reasonable duties corresponding to ability and training.

The position is expected to include up to 25 days of travel abroad per year.

We offer you:

  • The opportunity to work as part of a highly committed international team of skilled and experienced colleagues, united by a strong sense of purpose and a collaborative team spirit that has been successfully fostered across a remote working environment.
  • The chance to make a tangible contribution to international justice, supporting work that can have concrete, real-world impact for accountability.
  • A high degree of responsibility and meaningful involvement, with the opportunity to shape the work of the platform.
  • A stimulating and purpose-driven working environment, offering opportunities to engage with complex and international criminal law and accountability issues.
  • A supportive and collegial culture, where knowledge-sharing, mutual respect and constructive collaboration are valued.
  • The flexibility of an office environment or remote working environment, combined with an established culture of communication, collaboration and connection across the team.


Skills

We expect you to hold a university degree in law (at undergraduate or postgraduate level), preferably with a specialisation in international criminal law.

We also expect that you have:

  • A minimum of 10 years of demonstrated practical professional experience in the documentation of violations of international law, preferably in the context of international criminal law. This experience should include substantial hands-on investigative or documentation work and not be primarily academic in nature.
  • A minimum of 5 years analytical and investigative experience in relation to violations of international criminal law, in particular crimes against humanity, including the assessment and analysis of relevant facts, evidence, and applicable legal frameworks.
  • Demonstrated legal drafting skills, including experience in conceptualising, structuring and drafting of submissions to national and international human rights and accountability bodies.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating and overseeing the work of a team of analysts, including allocating and reviewing work and providing substantive guidance to members of the IAPB team in a remote working environment.
  • Experience with universal and extra-territorial jurisdiction cases.
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with criminal justice stakeholders, including national and/or international accountability bodies.
  • Experience representing an organisation at external events, including conferences or other forums, with the confidence to speak to a range of audiences.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English.
  • Fluency in Russian and/or Belarusian will be given particular weight in the selection process.
  • Direct experience interviewing survivors and witnesses is desirable.

It is also important that you have:

  • Excellent communication skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with different target audiences.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong organisational and inter-personal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an inter-disciplinary environment and across different cultures.
  • Ability to work across a broad portfolio, manage complex workload and be responsive to evolving demands.
  • Cultural and context sensitivity, high ethical standards, and diplomatic skills.
  • and that you are resourceful, creative, collegial, empathic, and respectful.


Terms of employment

The position is placed in the Secretariat of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB), of which DIGNITY is the lead organisation. The IAPB is managed by the Head of the Platform and Dignity’s Director of the Prevention & Accountability Department.

The position is placed in Dignity’s head office in Copenhagen (Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Kbh. Ø), but we alternatively offer an employer of record (EoR) solution if you are based in another EU member state. Please note that the position will not be filled on a consultancy basis.

The employment is based on the Danish collective agreement for academics in the Danish State, and the salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 50-52.500 (gross, monthly) + pension (18,07%). If you are offered an EoR solution, the salary will depend on comparable positions and terms of employment in the host country.

Expected entry is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter; the position is currently envisaged until 30 September 2029.


More info

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting the IAPB Secretariat at iapb@dignity.dk.

The application consisting of CV, letter of motivation, diploma and other documents if relevant are submitted via the link no later than 27 September 2026.

We expect to hold interviews on 15-16 October 2026 digitally, and possibly also a second round of interviews on 20-21 October 2026, which will also take place digitally.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: https://www.dignity.dk/privatlivspolitik/

The IAPB is composed of two Belarusian co-lead organisations, Human Rights Center Viasna and International Committee for the Investigation of Torture in Belarus, and its lead organisation DIGNITY – Danish Institute against Torture.

Since its establishment, it has continued to expand its evidence base and analytical outputs, collecting testimonies of some 2,900 victims and witnesses, over 38,000 victim-related documents and over 2.1 million open-source items, including extensive audiovisual and textual materials.

Cooperation with accountability mechanisms contributed to the decision of the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court to open an investigation into crimes against humanity related to the Lithuania/Belarus situation. Overall, by June 2026, the Platform had responded to 14 requests from national jurisdictions and prepared 13 submissions to multiple international mechanisms.

As part of its survivor-centred approach, so far it has provided mental health and psychosocial support to 850 beneficiaries.

Beyond documentation and support activities, the IAPB promotes accountability pathways for Belarus, outlined in its report “Paths to Accountability for Belarus”.

description:
Vi søger dansktalende kundeservicerådgivere til en international virksomhed med kontor i Athen, Grækenland. Stillingen er fuldtid, kontorbaseret og med ubegrænset ansættelseskontrakt.


Arbejdsopgaver

  • Kundeservice via telefon og e-mail

  • Håndtering af henvendelser fra danske kunder

  • Lejlighedsvis skriftlig og mundtlig kommunikation på engelsk

  • Anvendelse af interne systemer og værktøjer (på engelsk)

Kvalifikationer

  • Dansk på C2-niveau (skriftligt og mundtligt)

  • Engelsk på minimum B2-niveau

  • Gode kommunikationsevner

  • Struktureret og ansvarsbevidst arbejdsform

  • Almindelige IT-kundskaber

  • Villighed til at arbejde fra kontor i Athen


Arbejdstid

  • Mandag–fredag inden for tidsrummet 09:00–01:00
    (vagtplan med skift)

  • 8-timers vagter

Relocation-pakke

  • Flybillet til Athen

  • Transport fra lufthavnen

  • Midlertidig bolig (Airbnb) i 4 uger

  • Hjælp til udstedelse af nødvendige ansættelses- og opholdsdokumenter

Arbejdssted

  • Athen, Grækenland

  • Kontorbaseret stilling

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

  • Grundløn: 1300 EUR brutto pr. måned

  • 14-årlige lønninger (1 ekstra løn December, 0.5 ekstra løn til påske og 0,5 ekstra løn til sommer)

  • Performancebonus: Op til 10 % pr. måned baseret på performance og KPI’er
    (udbetales fra måned 4)

  • Arbejdsbonus: 5 EUR pr. arbejdsdag

  • Fast ansættelse med ubegrænset kontrakt

Send ansøgning og CV snarest. Samtaler afholdes løbende.

title: Cleaning Supervisor
description:
At duuo our mission is to empower our customers by providing customer centric advice and solutions, enabling them to focus on their core business and what really matters.

By working as a Cleaning Supervisor at duuo, you will be working with the Cleaning department - a team of around 120 dedicated staff members that are serving 150+ customers in central Copenhagen and ensure that the quality of cleaning at our customers meets duuo's standards at all times.

The work is exclusively evenings during the week, and weekends and you will be expected to work both Saturday and Sunday.

The supervisor role is primarily responsible for active quality assurance on site. Other duties will include:

  • Specialist Cleaning

  • Training and mentoring

  • Replacement cleaning in case of illness and other issues

To qualify of this role, we would like to hear from candidates that have the following:

  • 5 years cleaning experience in Denmark

  • Full and Valid Driving License

  • Fluent English

To excel in this role, you will need to following attributes:

  • Attention to detail

  • Good people & communication skills

  • Some knowledge of Danish

  • Good problem solving and ability to work independently.

The location and nature of the work will change daily, we need someone that is adaptable and flexible and able to think on their feet and react to lots of unknown situations. Alongside this you need good humour and patience as you will be working with different people and different locations.

If you see yourself in this role, we would love to hear from you.

title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 23, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Postdoc in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding our current deep learning approaches, while also having a chance to create your own novel approaches.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing data science projects within these consortia and the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Computer science (informatics)

  • Mathematics

  • Physics

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

We are particularly interested in candidates with strong analytical skills and interdisciplinary experience. Candidates with a solid data science background but lacking biological training are strongly encouraged to apply and include a statement about their motivation for this position and how they anticipate addressing this.

  • Experience with deep learning model architectures, including autoencoders, graph neural networks, and related neural network models.

  • Familiarity with explainable AI (xAI) methods for interpreting machine learning and deep learning models.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Experience in applying deep learning to biological problems.

  • Basic understanding of human disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

title: Qualified Carpenter with Glazing Experience - Construction - Lolland, Denmark
description:
Dansk version længere nede

Bonde Glas is looking for a qualified carpenter with knowledge or experience of the glazing trade to join our team on Lolland in southern Denmark.

You’ll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark (for example, EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit). Unfortunately, we’re not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

  • You are a qualified carpenter

  • You have knowledge or practical experience of the glazing trade

  • You have a valid driving licence

  • You can communicate in English

  • Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

  • A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

  • Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

  • Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

  • Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

  • Pension scheme

  • Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension

  • Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Please send your application to rekruttering@lolland.dk and write “Bonde Glas” in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe’s largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

Bonde Glas søger en uddannet tømrer med kendskab til eller erfaring fra glarmesterfaget til vores team på Lolland.

Dine kvalifikationer

  • Du er uddannet tømrer

  • Du har kendskab til eller praktisk erfaring med glarmesterfaget

  • Du har kørekort

  • Gyldigt asbestkursus er en stor fordel

Bonde Glas er en lokal glarmestervirksomhed på Lolland. Ud over glarmesterarbejde har virksomheden også tømrere ansat og udfører mange forskellige praktiske opgaver.

Første samtale kan afholdes online, hvis det er nødvendigt. Udvalgte kandidater kan blive inviteret til at besøge arbejdspladsen, inden der indgås en endelig ansættelsesaftale.

Martin Hansen

title: SCANDINAVIAN MEDICARE ApS SØGER SOSU MEDHJÆLPER TIL HJEMMEHJÆLP
description:
Er du omsorgsfuld, tålmodig og har du lyst til at gøre en forskel i hverdagen for et andet menneske? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Vi søger en engageret SOSU-medhjælper til hjemmepleje primært til støtte af en konkret klient, som er ældre og med betydelige synsproblemer. Hun har brug for støtte og hjælp til at få hverdagen til at fungere trygt og godt i eget hjem.

 

Om stillingen

Som SOSU-medhjælper vil du blandt andet have ansvar for:

-              At hjælpe med praktiske opgaver i hjemmet og skabe struktur i hverdagen

-              At yde personlig støtte og hjælp efter behov

-              At ledsage og støtte ved indkøb, gåture og andre daglige aktiviteter

-              At være med til at skabe tryghed og sikkerhed i hjemmet

-              At være opmærksom på hendes behov og kommunikere tydeligt og respektfuldt

-              At bidrage til en hyggelig positiv hverdag

Vi forventer at du:

-              Har en relevant uddannelse eller erfaring inden for pleje og omsorg

-              Er tålmodig, empatisk og omsorgsfuld

-              Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

-              Er mødestabil og fleksibel

-              Har forståelse for de udfordringer, der kan være forbundet med nedsat syn

-              Er god til at kommunikere og skabe tryg relation

-              Har en positiv indstilling og lyst til at gøre en forskel

-              Kan tale persisk eller armensk

Det er vigtigt, at du møder klienten med respekt og nærvær og har lyst til at blive en stabil og tryg del af hendes hverdag.

Vi tilbyder:

-              Et meningsfuldt og ansvarsfuldt arbejde, hvor du gør en konkret forskel

-              En hyggelig og rolig arbejdsplads i borgerens eget hjem

-              En tæt og tillidsfuld relation til borgeren

-              Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling

Lyder dette lyder som noget for dig, så send en ansøgning og dit CV til os på: medicare08@gmail.com

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Service Manager – Cleaning & Property Services
description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Service Manager to take responsibility for the daily operation and coordination of our cleaning and property service activities.

As Service Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring high service standards across our customer sites. You will be responsible for coordinating employees, planning daily operations, maintaining quality standards and ensuring professional communication with our customers.

The position combines leadership, operational planning and customer service, and we are therefore looking for someone who is comfortable taking responsibility and making decisions in a busy and dynamic working environment.

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Daily management and coordination of service employees

  • Planning and allocation of cleaning and property maintenance tasks

  • Ensuring that agreed service levels and quality standards are maintained

  • Conducting regular quality inspections at customer sites

  • Managing daily operational changes, including sickness, absence and replacement staff

  • Recruitment, onboarding and introduction of new employees

  • Preparing and maintaining work schedules

  • Maintaining regular communication with customers and following up on their requirements

  • Handling operational issues and ensuring that challenges are resolved quickly and professionally

  • Coordinating cleaning supplies, equipment and machinery

  • Planning and coordinating property maintenance services

  • Coordinating seasonal outdoor maintenance, including lawn mowing, hedge trimming and general upkeep of outdoor areas

  • Supporting employees and ensuring clear instructions and expectations

  • Reporting and following up on daily operations with management

Your Profile

We are looking for a responsible and service-minded person who enjoys working with both people and operations.

Ideally, you:

  • Have previous experience within cleaning, facility services, property services or a similar service industry

  • Have experience managing or coordinating employees

  • Have strong organisational and planning skills

  • Are able to work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities

  • Have a professional and customer-focused approach

  • Are solution-oriented and able to respond quickly when operational challenges arise

  • Are comfortable working in an environment where priorities may change during the day

  • Have basic IT skills and are comfortable using digital planning and communication tools

  • Hold a valid Category B driving licence

Previous experience with both commercial cleaning and property/outdoor maintenance is an advantage.

What We Offer

We offer an independent and responsible position in a growing service company where you will have a direct influence on daily operations and customer satisfaction.

You will be joining a company with short decision-making processes and a practical approach to solving challenges.

We offer:

  • A position with a high degree of responsibility and independence

  • A varied working day with both office and on-site responsibilities

  • Close cooperation with management, customers and employees

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

  • A dynamic working environment where no two days are exactly the same

title: Socialfaglig medarbejder / nattevagt/ vikar
description:
Socialfaglig medarbejder og fast tilkaldevikar søges til Toftehuset ApS

Der er tale om en fast stilling som socialfaglig medarbejder på 35 timer ugentligt og stillingen som fast vikaransættelse.
Angiv venligst i din ansøgning, hvilken stilling du er interesseret i.

Tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Om Toftehuset

Toftehuset ApS har gennem 18 år skabt trygge rammer for mennesker med forskellige problematikker som misbrug, hjemløshed og forskellige psykosociale barrierer. Vi holder til i Hviding tæt på Ribe og har plads til ni beboere fordelt på vores matrikel, der omfatter både lejligheder, en hytte og en udslusningsbolig.

Vores beboere er voksne over 18 år, der er visiteret efter §§ 101, 107 og 108 samt hjemløse, der har ophold jf. §110. Derudover tilbyder vi socialpædagogisk støtte efter §85 samt afsoning efter §78.

Vi søger en engageret socialfaglig medarbejder

Vil du gøre en forskel for mennesker, der har brug for støtte til at skabe en ny tilværelse?

Vi søger en engageret socialfaglig medarbejder til vores team. Arbejdstiden vil være 30 timer ugentligt, og der vil forekomme aften- og weekendvagter.

Som socialfaglig medarbejder bliver du en vigtig del af beboernes udvikling og hverdag. En central del af arbejdet er at støtte den enkelte beboer i at arbejde hen imod egne mål og delmål og i takt med deres forudsætninger udvikle færdigheder, struktur og selvstændighed.

Du vil blandt andet arbejde med ADL, sociale kompetencer, økonomi, bolig, kontakt til offentlige myndigheder samt støtte til at skabe struktur og sammenhæng i hverdagen. Du vil også deltage i husets daglige aktiviteter og ledsagelse.

En væsentlig del af arbejdet er desuden den socialfaglige dokumentation. Du skal kunne observere, beskrive og dokumentere beboernes udvikling, progression og udfordringer samt være med til løbende at følge op på de mål og delmål, der arbejdes med. Dokumentationen er en vigtig del af vores faglige arbejde og skal være med til at sikre, at indsatsen tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers behov og udvikling.

Dine kvalifikationer

  • Du har en relevant socialfaglig uddannelse, f.eks. socialpædagog eller lign. uddannelse.

  • Du har kørekort B.

  • Du er fleksibel og kan arbejde systematisk efter gældende retningslinjer.

  • Du er stabil, engageret og god til at opbygge tillidsfulde relationer.

  • Du kan fremvise straffeattest.

Dine ansvarsområder

  • Støtte og vejledning af beboerne i dagligdagens gøremål og udvikling af deres selvstændighed.

  • Arbejde målrettet med beboernes individuelle mål og delmål.

  • Observere og følge op på beboernes trivsel, udvikling og progression.

  • Udarbejde og ajourføre socialfaglig dokumentation.

  • Bidrage til statusbeskrivelser og evaluering af den socialfaglige indsats.

  • Deltage i husets daglige aktiviteter og ledsagelse.

  • Støtte beboerne i kontakten til offentlige myndigheder, sundhedsvæsen, familie og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere.

  • Indgå aktivt i det tværfaglige samarbejde omkring den enkelte beboer.

Vi tilbyder

  • En meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du gør en konkret forskel for mennesker i udsatte positioner.

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på relationer, udvikling og faglighed.

  • Et dedikeret og engageret team.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og supervision.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til at bringe egne faglige kompetencer og idéer i spil.

 

Ansøgninger med relevante bilag sendes pr. mail til leder@toftehuset.dk

title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: Allround-håndværker søges til fast ansættelse/All-round tradesperson wanted for full-time position
description:
Dansk:

Vi søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst allround-håndværker, som har primært erfaring og gode faglige kompetencer inden for tømrer- og malerfaget.

Arbejdsopgaverne vil blandt andet omfatte tømrerarbejde og mindre renoveringsopgaver, opbygning og afretning af undergulve, lægning af klikgulve, lamelgulve og massive trægulve samt montering af lister, paneler, aflslibning af trægulve og behandling af trægulve. Derudover vil arbejdet bestå af spartling, opsætning af filt og maling af vægge, lofter og træværk.

Der kan også forekomme reparationer, vedligeholdelse og forskellige mindre håndværksopgaver, som kan berøre eller trække på andre håndværksfag.

Vi leder efter en fagligt dygtig og alsidig person med relevant brancheerfaring. Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for dine opgaver og levere et pænt resultat med fokus på kvalitet og detaljer.

Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk. Kørekort er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder fast fuldtidsansættelse med ordnede forhold, løn efter kvalifikationer og varierede opgaver i Storkøbenhavn og Nordsjælland. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, ansvarlighed og høj faglig kvalitet vægtes højt.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt mandag til fredag kl. 7.00–15.00. Opstart hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Hvis stillingen lyder som noget for dig, bedes du sende en kort ansøgning og dit CV til info@gp-byggeservice.dk.

English:

We are looking for an experienced and responsible all-round tradesperson with strong practical skills and experience, primarily within carpentry and painting.

The work will include carpentry and minor renovation projects, building and levelling subfloors, installing click flooring, engineered flooring and solid wooden floors, as well as fitting trims, skirting boards, floor sanding and floor coating. The position will also involve filling, installing wall lining and painting walls, ceilings and woodwork.

There may also be various repair and maintenance tasks, as well as smaller assignments involving other building trades.

We are looking for a skilled and versatile professional with relevant industry experience. You must be able to work independently, take responsibility for your assignments and deliver high-quality results with attention to detail.

You must be able to communicate in Danish or English. A valid driver’s licence is an advantage but not a requirement.

We offer permanent full-time employment with proper working conditions, salary based on qualifications and varied projects across Greater Copenhagen and North Zealand. You will join a company with a positive working environment where teamwork, responsibility and professional quality are highly valued.

Working hours are generally Monday to Friday from 7:00 to 15:00. The position is available for an immediate start or by agreement.

If this position sounds suitable for you, please send a short application and your CV to info@gp-byggeservice.dk.

title: Senior Immersion Engineer
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a naval architect, maritime engineer or offshore engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbor (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As an Immersion Engineer, you will participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In the first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In the second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, assisting the Immersion Master by giving technical advice.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

  • During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

  • You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

  • You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands

  • You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

  • You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

  • You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

  • During float up and ballasting you check if the operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

  • During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations.

  • You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

  • After immersion, you will do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

  • You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

  • You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

  • You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

  • You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

  • You are a team player with strong communication skills

  • You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

  • You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

title: Site Engineer, Mechanical for Renewables; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Aarhus, Worldwide
description:
If you are as passionate about sustainability and the green transition as we are, then this is a great opportunity for you to join an international company in growth as our new Site Engineer, Mechanical for our Renewables Division!
 
Your position 

As our new Site Engineer, Mechanical at Semco Maritime you will join an experienced, highly skilled and passionate team of engineers in our Renewables division. This team has been responsible for creating one of the largest project portfolios within offshore substations worldwide.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 
We are working on sites globally in our markets, including Europe, Asia and the USA. So, traveling work is the standard and we work both offshore and onshore.

Your tasks & responsibilities 

You will be involved in the construction of offshore substation for windfarms and distribution/transmission projects world-wide. You, together with your team will be responsible for installations, tests, and commissioning of mechanical systems such as ventilation systems, cooling systems, fire extinguishing system, diesel generator system and fuel system.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

  • Coordinating and managing daily site activities for 4-10 skilled workers
  • Ensuring that the project activities adhere to the schedule and activities are planned accordingly
  • Coordinate and plan with installation suppliers / yard / partners
  • Purchase and overseeing the timely delivery of materials and coordination with vendors
  • Plan and align with Engineering department on changes in design and/or other topics
  • Ad-hoc daily tasks and problem solving
  • Run and manage start-up and commissioning of mechanical systems

Your profile & qualifications 

We imagine that you are an ambitious and talented professional with a keen eye for detail. You are also a dedicated team player with a positive attitude as well as good commercial awareness and managerial skills.
 
To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Preferred to have a master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, marine engineering or similar
  • Have prior hands-on experience with some of the mechanical systems
  • Have experience working with staff and supplier contracts
  • Possess a safety-first mindset
  • Would like to work in an international setting where a lot of traveling is required to go to the sites
  • Have effective interpersonal skills and great communication skills in English

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 
Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  
We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   
Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Senior Research Adviser for EU, International Funding, Innovation and Impact, Faculty of Health Sciences
description:
Are you curious about how FP10 will change the opportunities and requirements facing universities? Are you interested in the growing expectations for innovation and impact arising from research? And would you like to work both strategically and closely with researchers and projects, with one clear objective: to strengthen SUND’s international position and secure more external funding?

Then you could play a central role in SUND Research Support. We are looking for an experienced research adviser who from 1 December 2026 can serve as our key specialist for EU and international funding opportunities – and help prepare the unit for tomorrow’s requirements in relation to funding, project delivery, innovation and societal impact.

Responsibilities
You will take an overview of EU and international funding: from developments in Horizon Europe and FP10 to specific calls, partnerships and opportunities for SUND researchers. You will translate policy and programme developments into action and help us position ourselves early as new agendas emerge.

The role spans strategic intelligence and portfolio oversight through to hands-on advice and coordination of prioritised initiatives. Some days you will work on long-term EU positioning and pipeline development; on others, closely with a researcher, an international consortium or a specific call. We do not expect you to do everything yourself, but you will need to spot opportunities, bring together the right expertise and drive progress.

Innovation and impact are important parts of the role. You will strengthen our impact-upfront approach and ensure that requirements relating to involvement, uptake, implementation and knowledge valorisation are considered early. At the same time, you will contribute to a smooth transition from pre-award to post-award, so that project delivery is considered from the outset and lessons from funded projects and project implementation feed into new applications.

You will be both a key contributor to specific EU and international initiatives and a co-developer of our shared models, workflows and portfolio overview. The aim is a more coherent approach to international funding – not simply more individual applications.

Qualifications
We are looking for an experienced professional who thrives at the intersection of research, EU policy, funding, innovation and impact. You have solid experience of EU or international funding, research development or research support, and a good knowledge of Horizon Europe or other major international programmes.

You work strategically and analytically but are also keen to turn insight into tangible results. You are a strong coordinator and relationship-builder who can navigate complex processes, bring together expertise and build trust with researchers, colleagues and management. You communicate confidently in both Danish and English.
It is an advantage if you also have experience of areas such as EU policy, international consortia, Brussels networks, post-award, innovation, societal impact or knowledge valorisation. We do not expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. A PhD or other research experience may be an advantage but is not essential.

In addition, you have an understanding of and a desire to work with digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) in relation to optimizing processes and creating value within the organization. 

About SUND Research Support and the Faculty of Health Sciences
SUND Research Support assists researchers at the Faculty of Health Sciences at SDU from the early idea and funding opportunity through to application, project delivery, innovation and impact.

We aim to work more proactively with funding intelligence, positioning, partnerships and long-term pipelines – and to create stronger links between pre-award, post-award, innovation and impact. At the same time, we want to use data, organisational learning and AI more systematically.

You will have the opportunity both to work directly with researchers and projects and to help shape how a modern research support function should operate in the years ahead. You will play a central role in SUND’s international funding activities in the run-up to FP10 and help create stronger links between EU/international funding, post-award, innovation and impact.

You will work closely with strong health sciences research environments, management teams and colleagues with a range of specialist profiles. We are interested in new ways of working and in how data, digital tools and AI can add value to research support. This is an opportunity both to deliver results today and to help shape how we work tomorrow.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.
As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

Read more about the Faculty of Health Sciences here.

Contact
If you would like more information about the position, you are welcome to contact head of SUND Research Support Anne Kathrine Overgaard, tlf. 60111043, e-mail: aovergaard@health.sdu.dk or Head of Education and Secretariat Merete Munk på mmunk@health.sdu.dk.

Application Process
The application deadline is 29 September 2026 at 11:59 PM. We expect to conduct interviews 7 October 2026. 

Employment starts on 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Salary and Terms of Employment
Your place of employment will be the University of Southern Denmark in Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

There may be limited travel activity to other SDU campus cities.

Employment is in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and collective agreement for academics (AC).

The position is full time.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range of the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

If you are interested in the position, you must submit an application that includes a cover letter, CV indicating months and years (without photo), and diploma. All documents related to the application should not contain photos or CPR numbers – if so, the CPR number must be redacted.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. The cover letter and CV must not exceed 5 MB.

Guidance on the application process can be found here.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified applicants, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About SDU
The University of Southern Denmark exists to create value for and with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we aim to make a positive difference for society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talent. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. It is the university’s researchers, teachers, students, leaders, and technical-administrative staff who form the foundation of our success.

title: Senior Software Engineer! Build production software – and raise the engineering bar around you
description:
If your definition of seniority is more than simply having written code for many years, this could be interesting.

Cubris develops software that helps rail operators run smarter, safer and more sustainable railway services.

As part of Hitachi Rail, we are now strengthening our engineering organisation and developing Cubris into a high-performing technology competence centre around our GreenSpeed® platform.

We are therefore looking for a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong hands-on development skills with technical ownership.

This is not a role where you receive a Jira ticket, implement it and move on.

You will take ownership of delivery within a product area – from understanding requirements and making implementation decisions to coordinating development, identifying risks and getting robust software into production.

What you will do

You will:

  • Design, develop and ship production-grade software

  • Translate requirements into clear technical tasks and solutions

  • Take ownership of technical execution within a product area

  • Coordinate development across multiple engineers when required

  • Identify dependencies, blockers and technical risks before they affect delivery

  • Challenge unclear requirements constructively

  • Participate actively in design discussions and technical reviews

  • Design and document architecture at component level

  • Develop and maintain release pipelines

  • Work closely with Product and Quality Engineering

  • Support colleagues through technical sparring, reviews and coaching

  • Improve code quality, testability, maintainability and delivery practices

The role is deliberately broader than coding alone. Cubris expects senior engineers to take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.

What you bring

We are looking for substantial software engineering experience and a strong track record of taking software from requirements into production.

Your technical foundation should include:

  • Strong C#/.NET experience

  • Docker/container experience

  • Azure DevOps Cloud

  • Solid software design fundamentals

  • Testing and code-quality practices

  • CI/CD and modern delivery workflows

  • Debugging and performance thinking

  • Database and data-access experience

Experience with .NET MAUI, Blazor, Android/device-based UI or embedded UI solutions is relevant for parts of the GreenSpeed® environment and would be an advantage.

But technical skills alone are not enough.

You should also be comfortable creating momentum when requirements are ambiguous, making sound engineering decisions and helping other developers become better. The formal role description specifically calls for experience leading technical initiatives without necessarily having formal people-management responsibility.

Why Cubris?

You join at a point where your experience can make a visible difference.

You will work close to Product, Quality Engineering and experienced technical colleagues while helping define the standards, tools and engineering practices of the organisation Cubris is becoming.

You get:

  • A technically meaningful product

  • Direct influence on engineering decisions

  • A focused Danish technology environment

  • International reach through Hitachi Rail

  • The opportunity to help build the engineering culture rather than simply become part of an established one

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Company: Cubris – a Hitachi Rail company

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

title: Tech Lead! 50% Lead Developer. 50% Software Architect. 100% technical leadership.
description:
Are you the engineer people turn to when the code is difficult, the architecture matters and the team needs a technical direction?

Cubris is strengthening its engineering organisation around GreenSpeed® as part of our ambition to build a high-performing technology competence centre for intelligent railway solutions within Hitachi Rail.

We are looking for a Tech Lead who combines deep hands-on software engineering with architectural judgement.

This is deliberately not a traditional management role.

You will spend approximately 50% of your time as a Lead Developer and 50% as a Software Architect – building production software, solving difficult engineering problems and coaching developers while also representing your team in the Architecture Group and translating architectural direction into practical solutions.

Your role as Lead Developer

You will:

  • Write and ship production code

  • Take ownership of technically complex stories

  • Unblock other engineers when problems become difficult

  • Coach developers through pairing, design discussions and high-quality PR reviews

  • Raise standards for automated testing and CI/CD

  • Improve pipeline reliability and engineering effectiveness

  • Strengthen observability through logs, metrics and traces

  • Drive systematic reduction of technical debt

  • Establish useful patterns, runbooks and reference implementations

In other words: you are expected to remain technically credible because you are still doing the work.

Your role as Software Architect

At the same time, you will:

  • Represent your team in Cubris’ Architecture Group

  • Translate architectural decisions and ADRs into practical team standards

  • Define service boundaries, APIs, events and data contracts

  • Establish and verify non-functional requirements around security, reliability, performance and cost

  • Lead technical migrations and integrations

  • Manage architectural dependencies and compatibility

  • Maintain architectural documentation, roadmaps and decision records

You become the technical bridge between Product, Engineering and Architecture.

What you bring

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience

  • Experience leading technical initiatives or engineering teams

  • Strong C#/.NET expertise

  • Experience designing distributed systems and/or microservices

  • Good SQL/NoSQL fundamentals

  • Experience with APIs, domain modelling and event-driven architectures

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD and modern software delivery

  • Experience with cloud technologies, containers and orchestration

  • An engineering mindset around reliability, observability, security and performance

  • The ability to mentor developers and communicate technical decisions clearly

The current environment includes C#/.NET, .NET Core, Entity Framework, MS SQL Server, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD and Visual Studio, with Azure, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code increasingly relevant.

Why Cubris?

Because you will have unusually visible technical influence.

You will not simply inherit somebody else's engineering system. You will help define how Cubris builds software: the architecture, engineering practices, quality standards and technical guardrails that enable the organisation to scale.

And the software has a tangible purpose: helping make modern railway operations smarter, more predictable and more energy-efficient.

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Department: Software Production
Reports to: Development Manager

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

title: Chef- Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 

WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.
