Please submit your application, CV, and any other relevant documents electronically to this e-mail: m.cederstroem@rn.dk

Interviews: Expected to take place shortly after the application deadline.

Starting date: 1th of October 2026 or earlier by agreement.

title: Paving Worker / Landscaping Construction Worker – Practical Skills
description:
Work location: Denmark
Working hours: 37 hours per week
Employment type: Full-time, permanent position
Salary: After qualificatons
Start date: By agreement

About the position

We are looking for practical and reliable employees to carry out paving and landscaping construction work in Denmark.

The position is suitable for candidates who have good practical skills, an aptitude for manual work and an interest in construction and outdoor work.

A formal vocational qualification as a paving worker or landscaper is not required.

Instead, we value practical experience, a good understanding of manual work, accuracy, reliability and the ability to learn new working methods.

Main duties

The work will primarily include:

  • Paving and surfacing work

  • Laying paving stones, concrete slabs, cobblestones, kerbstones and other paving materials

  • Measuring, setting out and preparing work areas

  • Excavation and preparation of ground and sub-base

  • Levelling and compacting sub-base and sand

  • Cutting and adapting paving materials

  • Establishing and adjusting edges, levels and gradients

  • Minor landscaping and groundworks

  • Using hand tools and small construction machinery

  • General maintenance and cleaning of the work area

  • Following applicable health, safety and environmental regulations

The exact tasks may vary depending on the project and the employee's practical experience.

We are looking for someone who

  • Has a natural aptitude for practical and manual work

  • Is comfortable with physically demanding work

  • Works accurately and takes pride in the quality of their work

  • Can work independently based on instructions

  • Works well as part of a team

  • Is reliable, punctual and responsible

  • Is motivated to learn and develop practical skills

  • Preferably has previous experience in paving, landscaping, construction, groundworks, installation, renovation or other practical work

A formal vocational qualification is not required.

Relevant practical experience from construction, civil works, groundworks, installation, renovation, agriculture or other practical occupations is considered an advantage.

Language requirements

English is an advantage.

Danish is not required at the time of employment. However, the employee must be able to understand relevant work instructions and health and safety instructions sufficiently to perform the work safely.

Salary and employment conditions

The fixed and guaranteed salary is:

DKK 37,500 gross per month for 37 hours of work per week.

In addition, the employer provides an occupational pension in accordance with the applicable employment terms.

The fixed cash salary corresponds to your qualifications

The salary is fixed and guaranteed and is not dependent on bonuses, commissions or overtime.

Employment conditions, including working hours, pension, holiday entitlement, overtime and notice periods, will be specified in the employment contract and will comply with applicable Danish legislation and customary Danish employment conditions for the position.

Occupation / DISCO-08

DISCO-08: 711220 – Paving Work

The position specifically involves paving and surfacing work, including the preparation, installation and finishing of paved surfaces.

What we offer

  • Permanent full-time employment in Denmark

  • 37-hour working week

  • Fixed salary matched to your qualifications

  • Training and introduction to the company's working methods

  • Varied projects within paving and landscaping construction

  • A professional working environment

  • Opportunity to develop practical and manual skills

How to apply

Please send your CV and a short description of your previous work experience.

You do not need to have a formal vocational qualification.

Instead, please describe the practical work you have previously performed, the tools or machinery you have experience using, and the types of tasks you are accustomed to carrying out.

Candidates will be assessed based on their practical experience, aptitude for manual work, motivation, reliability and ability to learn.

This is a genuine full-time position in Denmark and the vacancy will be advertised through Jobnet and EURES.

title: Chef- Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 

WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.

title: Production Worker (Day/night)
description:
Would you like to help ensure a more sustainable future? Vestas is currently looking for unskilled workers with experience in production work. We are looking for someone who wants to help ensure quality and prioritize safety and well-being in the workplace.

Being hired as a production worker at Vestas is not just about experience, it's about motivation, curiosity, and interest in learning new things. Through thorough training and instruction, we will provide you with all the tools to become skilled at making wind turbines. The Nakskov factory produces blades for our offshore wind turbines; the factory is an epoxy workplace, so everyone must complete an epoxy course or have a certificate no older than 5 years.

This posting is for those who thrive on working 12-hour shifts, either day or night.

Responsibilities

  • Safety: At Vestas, safety is the first priority, which means you must prioritize your own and your colleagues' safety, both physically and mentally.
  • Quality: Our next priority is top-notch quality, so we expect you to take pride in producing a product that meets standards.
  • Production Plan: At Vestas, we also have some plans that need to be met to deliver on time. So, we expect an employee who is diligent and strives to meet deadlines without compromising safety or quality.

Qualifications

  • You are in good physical shape and accustomed to standing and walking throughout the workday.
  • It is advantageous if you have experience with 5S and Lean.
  • It is advantageous if you have experience with production work, but if you are willing to learn, we would like to hear from you.

Competencies

  • You are quality-conscious and focus on safety.
  • You contribute to creating a good atmosphere at work.
  • You don't mind changing tasks.
  • You have an interest in learning new things and are curious.

We Offer

A workplace with a focus on employees, their safety, and providing them with the tools to create quality in their work. We offer an attractive salary package with health insurance, dental insurance, and a canteen arrangement.

Additional Information

  • Workplace: Nakskov
  • Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.
  • Reference check will occur after interviews. Please state in your application if you have a reference. 

Our commitment to a fair hiring.
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

DEIB Statement
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process

About Vestas
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 185 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 30,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

title: DIAS Fellow in Engineering within Robotics
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Robotics. The candidate is expected to start on January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of Robotics, who is eager to develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should demonstrate: 

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

  • Have research experience in computer vision fields related to laboratory automation. This could include (but is not limited to) methods for:

    • vision-based handling of laboratory equipment, in particular glassware and fluids 

    • segmentation and vision-based handling of medical specimens and fluids

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of Robotics, such as robotics control, modelling, computer vision, medical/industrial robotics and artificial intelligence. 

  • Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries. 

  • Be fluent in English.

  • Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network, are considered comparative advantages.

  • Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally. 

 

The Department

MMMI

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The institute is the origin of robotics research in Denmark and has spawned the world-renowned cluster of robotics in Odense with more than 130 robotics companies including Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots. Building on our expertise in AI, robotics and software, we have raised strong research centres in related domains, such as Health Informatics and Energy Informatics, Drones and other relevant research areas. 

SDU Robotics

SDU Robotics conducts research among others within the fields of robotics and computer vision. The unit focuses on research problems from real robotics applications within manufacturing industries, hospitals, elderly care, and other partners in society. The unit also focuses on Robot related vision technologies for facilitating industrial part feeding, automated product assembly, uncertainty aware quality inspection, and biomedical segmentation for diagnosis and robot control. 

SDU Robotics’ research involves mathematical modeling and control of robots, robotic processes and robot systems, human-robot interactions, computer vision for reliable inspection and robot control, and simulation technologies for robotics and computer vision aimed at closing the Sim2Real gap. Artificial Intelligence is widely applied within all research fields. 

 

Additional information

For further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For more questions about the position please contact Head of Unit, Professor Thiusius Rajeeth Savarimuthu at trs@mmmi.sdu.dk.

title: Postdoc in material flow analysis and resource management
description:
The SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a postdoctoral position in material flow analysis and resource management. The position is initially offered for one year, with the possibility of extension depending on available funding.

The position will focus on quantitative assessment of material and resource systems. The work will involve analysis of material stocks and flows, resource use, waste management and recycling, and associated environmental impacts across different material systems and end-use sectors.

The postdoc will apply material flow analysis, life cycle assessment and scenario analysis to support research on resource and waste management. Application areas may include plastics, phosphorus, critical raw materials and other material systems.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

·         Quantifying material stocks and flows across different material systems and end-use sectors

·         Assessing secondary resource availability and future resource demand

·         Applying life cycle assessment and scenario analysis

·         Contributing to scientific publications and research projects

·         Contributing to teaching and supervision within relevant areas

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

·         A PhD in environmental engineering, industrial ecology, environmental science or a related field

·         Strong experience with material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, and scenario analysis

·         Strong quantitative and analytical skills

·         A strong publication record in relevant international journals

·         Experience in international research collaboration

·         Good written and spoken English

·         Ability to work independently and as part of a research team

Experience with plastics, phosphorus, critical raw materials or related resource systems will be considered an advantage. 

Research environment

As a postdoc, you will conduct independent research, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy and energy system optimization.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with external partners, including international conferences and research visits.

Application

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • PhD degree certificate(s)

  • A list of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

title: DIAS Fellow in Engineering within Organoid Intelligence
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Organoid Intelligence. The candidate is expected to start on January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of Organoid Intelligence, capable of combining multiple disciplines, including Neuroscience, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and Bioimaging. The candidate must develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should: 

  • Drive internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition.

  • Publish in high-level peer-reviewed academic journals.

  • Engage in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • Play an active role in securing external funding, including both EU and Danish sources.

  • Commit to excellence in teaching at both undergraduate and graduate levels, including participation in teaching, development of new courses, and supervision of BSc, MSc, and PhD students.

  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams on artificial intelligence, neuroscience, biochemistry and molecular biology, bioimaging, and across various domains, also in the framework of DIAS.

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of data science such as AI and machine learning, neuroscience, physics and applied mathematics. Experience working within bioimaging is an advantage but not a precondition.

  • Demonstrate an outstanding track record to be qualified at the Assistant Professor level by the hiring time. The candidate may have experience at the Assistant Professor level or must be qualified at the time of being hired. The candidate may also have postdoctoral experience and may already have experience at the assistant professor level.

  • Demonstrate a strong track record of research and scientific publication.

  • Have a well-documented teaching record. 

  • Be fluent in English; the ability to communicate in Danish is an advantage but not a precondition.

  • Exhibit a commitment to excellence and multidisciplinary collaboration.

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally. 

 

MMMI

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The institute is the origin of robotics research in Denmark and has spawned the world-renowned cluster of robotics in Odense with more than 130 robotics companies including Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots. Building on our expertise in AI, robotics and software, we have raised strong research centres in related domains, such as Health Informatics and Energy Informatics, Drones and other relevant research areas.

SDU Applied AI and Data Science (SDU-AID)

SDU Applied AI and Data Science is one of MMMI’s 12 units and conducts interdisciplinary research in artificial intelligence and data science within the medical and energy sector, where we apply artificial intelligence and data science to improve procedures, provide information for decision makers and gain new knowledge.

SDU-AID’s backgrounds span from pure science (including mathematics and physics) to applied disciplines (such as biostatistics, epidemiology, computer science, and engineering). This gives the team a broad perspective on researching new, innovative solutions in a variety of fields.

The focus lies on the application of artificial intelligence and data science to advance research and provide data-driven solutions within the medical and energy sectors. Due to our long presence at SDU, we have established over the years strong collaborations with clinical researchers and companies, both in Denmark and abroad. Together with our collaborators, we are improving the way of handling and gaining insight from data, therefore creating knowledge and value for society.

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description:
Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:

At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations.

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team.

About the role

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value.

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work.

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems
  • Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities
  • Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness
  • Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs)
  • Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures
  • Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments
  • Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships

What you bring

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value:

  • Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies
  • Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers
  • Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects

Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued):

  • Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement
  • Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces
  • Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management

In addition, you bring:

  • Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
  • A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
  • Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
  • Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
  • Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition

The team you will join

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.

What we offer

  • A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company
  • Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations
  • A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues
  • A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning
  • Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.


About BeGreen

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities.

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets.

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.

title: Kok søges til stabil virksomhed i Hedehusene
description:
Chef wanted for stable company

Bollinis Restaurant ApS

v/Özgü Bayraktar

 

Bollinis in Hedehusene is looking for 2 full-time chefs!

 

Do you have a flair for good food, and do you thrive in a kitchen with lots of life? We are extremely busy at Bollinis and are therefore looking for a skilled full-time chef to strengthen our team.

We are a cozy, restaurant located super centrally on the main street in Hedehusene - within walking distance of both the station and the bus.

 

About the job:

As a chef with us, you get an exciting and varied everyday life. We run a delicious but simple a la carte card for our regular guests. In addition, we often provide the framework for larger parties, where we put together a special, tailor-made menu. You will therefore have ample opportunity to work with different types of cooking and serving within different kitchens.

 

Working hours:

Your normal working hours will be within the hours of 10.00 and 22.00. We are open every day of the week with the exception of Monday, when we are always closed.

 

We imagine that you:

  • Have experience as a chef (preferably educated, but experience can also do it).

  • Can maintain an overview and deliver quality – even when there are many orders on the screen.

  • Is stable, responsible and a good colleague.

·        Cares about sending out food that you are proud of.

We offer:

  • A full-time position in a restaurant in good development.

  • A workplace with high ceilings and an informal tone.

·        Good, dedicated colleagues who pull together.

Is it you we are looking for?

Then we would love to hear from you by email!

We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and hire when we have found the right person.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Nõutav on reaalne kogemus component-level / board-level remondiga.** Kandidaat peab suutma iseseisvalt: * lugeda elektriskeeme ja boardview-faile; * mõista emaplaadi põhiliste sõlmede tööpõhimõtteid; * leida rikke tegeliku põhjuse, mitte lihtsalt vahetada kahtlusaluseid komponente; * töötada multimeetri, laboratoorse toiteploki, ostsilloskoobi ja jootmisseadmetega; * teha kvaliteetset SMD-jootmist; * teha BGA remonti ja reballing'ut; * diagnoosida toiteahelaid; * tuvastada sülearvuti emaplaadi rikkeid komponenditasandil. Kui sinu tugevus on **sülearvutite emaplaatide diagnostika ja remont komponenditasandil** ning tunned end elektriskeemidega töötades kindlalt, siis soovime sinuga ühendust võtta. Tuleb kasuks * pikaajaline praktiline kogemus erinevate tootjate sülearvutite remondiga; * mänguriarvutite ja mängurisülearvutite remondi kogemus; * BGA-remondi ja reballing'u kogemus; * kaasaegsete sülearvutite skeemitehnika hea tundmine; * oskus töötada ka siis, kui valmis lahendust internetist ei leia; * vedelikukahjustustega ja tõsiselt kahjustatud emaplaatide remondi kogemus; * mängukonsoolide ja nutitelefonide komponenditasandi remondi kogemus. title: Systems Engineer – Aerospace & Optical Communications
description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

description:
Inglise keele õpetaja huviringi lastele

Tööülesanded: Õpetaja ülesanne on 4-9 aastastele lastele mängulise huviringi tunni ettevalmistamine ning seeläbi inglise keele õpetamine. Õpetajale on abiks huvikooli õppekava, materjalid, koolitused ja sõbralik töökollektiiv, kellega on võimalik oma rõõme, muresid ja ideid alati arutada.
Ühe huviringi tunni pikkuseks on 40 minutit ning tunnid toimuvad lasteaedades (ja koolides) nii Haapsalus kui ka selle ümbruses. Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning algavad enamasti alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Töö paindlik graafik ning väike koormus (1-12 tundi nädalas) sobivad väga hästi kooli või teise töö kõrvalt töötamiseks. Tööülesannete hulka kuuluvad lisaks tunni ettevalmistamisele ja tunni läbiviimisele ka laste kohaloleku märkimine Google'i tabelisse ning tunni kokkuvõtte saatmine lapsevanematele.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie õpetajad töötavad toetavas ja teineteist hoidvas kollektiivis, kus ükski mure ei jää lahendamata. Korraldame õppeaasta jooksul mitmeid koolitusi esile kerkivatel teemadel ning veedame niisama mõnusalt koos aega.
Õpetajal on vabadus kujundada omanäoline tund! Selleks pakume omalt poolt mahukat õppematerjalide ning -laulude kogumikku, kuid lõpuks kujundab iga õpetaja oma tunnid ise. Kui materjalidest või mõtetest jääb väheks, aitavad tunnni ettevalmistusel kaasõpetajad ja huvikooli õppejuht. Pakume osalist ning paindlikku tööaega (1-12 tundi nädalas). Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning hakkavad tavaliselt alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Nii jääb aega kooli või muude tegevuste jaoks. Meie õpetajad teenivad konkureerivat töötasu. Samuti hüvitame transpordikulud nii isikliku auto kui ühistranspordiga sõites.

title: Laboratory Sales Manager to GC Nordic
description:
GC Corporation was founded in 1921 in Japan and has developed itself into one of the most prominent companies in the development, production and distribution of a very wide range of dental products. GC Europe (Leuven, Belgium) supports and leads our different sales offices and dealers in EMEA territory. Our Nordic Team is currently looking for a

Laboratory Sales Manager, NordicPurpose of the job

As a Laboratory Sales Manager you will drive sales growth and business development for our laboratory and CAD/CAM product portfolio across the Nordic region. The ideal candidate brings strong commercial experience within the dental laboratory sector and a solid understanding of digital CAD/CAM workflows used in laboratories and dental clinics.

Your Role

    

Lead and develop our business in laboratory and CAD/CAM segment: Drive sales and business development activities across Nordic, ensuring achievement of sales targets and growth objectives. Geographically main focus is on Sweden, Norway and Denmark.

    

Account management: Build and maintain strong relationships with dental laboratories, digitally focused distributors, and key opinion leaders.

    

Product trainings and presentations: Conduct product demonstrations and training sessions that showcase customer-focused solutions, drive sales growth, and clearly demonstrate the value of the GC portfolio.

    

Market insights: Stay up-to-date with market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and mitigate challenges.

    

Team collaboration: Support and work closely with the broader GC Nordic team to ensure alignment and knowledge-sharing across markets.

What You Bring?

    

Proven experience (minimum 4 years) within the dental laboratory industry, including CAD/CAM workflows, ideally gained in a sales role.

    

Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills.

    

Results-oriented and proactive person who enjoys working independently in a fast-paced environment where multiple priorities need to be managed simultaneously.

    

Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English.

    

Willingness to travel on weekly basis, being 60%-80% of the working time in the field.

    

Resident of Sweden (working remote).

Why Join GC Nordic?

• An opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping our growth journey in the Nordic region.

• A vibrant company culture rooted in mutual respect, camaraderie, and a shared drive for success.

• A supportive team environment that values joy and celebrates collective and individual achievements.

• Chance to enjoy autonomy in your role, with the freedom to innovate and inspire across our various territories.

• An opportunity to contribute to a better, healthier world in collaboration with colleagues who are passionate about what they do.

description:
**Liikunnanohjaaja, Tanssittava**

**Tanssittava etsii uusia liikunnanohjaajia joukkoonsa!**

Tanssittava on kasvava tanssi- ja liikuntastudio, joka tarjoaa monipuolista ja helposti lähestyttävää toimintaa eri-ikäisille harrastajille. Toimimme useilla toimipisteillä **Pirkanmaalla** ja tunneillamme käy viikoittain satoja harrastajia. Toimintaperiaatteemme perustuvat sensitiivisyyteen, ja toimintaamme ohjaavia arvoja ovat yksilöllisyys, laadukkuus sekä asiakkaidemme kokonaisvaltaisen hyvinvoinnin tukeminen.

Etsimme joukkoomme **ammattitaitoista, innostavaa ja luotettavaa liikunnanohjaajaa.**

**Opetustunteja tarjolla**

Tarjoamme **sijaistuksia ja tiiviskursseja jo heti**, joten ohjaamisen voi aloittaa nopeasti. **Vakiintuneempia viikoittaisia tunteja on tarjolla tammikuusta 2027 alkaen.**

Ohjaustunteja on tarjolla pääasiassa **iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin**. Tunteja on mahdollista tarjota myös aamu -ja päiväaikaan.

Etsimme monipuolisia liikunnanohjaajia, joilla on osaamista esimerkiksi ryhmäliikunnasta, kehonhuollosta, liikkuvuudesta, pilateksesta, joogasta, tai toiminnallisesta harjoittelusta. **Myös muiden lajien ja tuntikonseptien osaaminen kiinnostaa!** Jos sinulla on mielessäsi laji tai tuntikonsepti, jota Tanssittavan valikoimassa ei vielä ole, kerro siitä rohkeasti hakemuksessasi.

**Toivomme sinulta**

- liikunta-alan koulutusta ja/tai vahvaa osaamista omalta lajialaltasi

- aikaisempaa kokemusta ryhmien ohjaamisesta

- innostavaa ja kannustavaa ohjaustapaa

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- vastuullista ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa

- halua kehittää omaa ohjaamistaan ja Tanssittavan tuntitarjontaa


**Tarjoamme**

- sijaistuksia ja tiiviskursseja jo syksyllä 2026

- mahdollisuuksia vakiotunteihin tammikuusta 2027 alkaen

- ohjaustunteja iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin

- mahdollisuuden ehdottaa ja toteuttaa uusia lajeja ja tuntikonsepteja

- joustavuutta tuntimäärien ja opetuksen suhteen

- mahdollisuuden olla mukana kehittämässä kasvavan studion toimintaa

- mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä meille vapaamuotoinen hakemus, jossa kerrot lyhyesti itsestäsi, koulutuksestasi, ohjauskokemuksestasi ja omasta osaamisestasi.

Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös:

- mitä lajeja tai tuntikonsepteja haluaisit ohjata

- milloin olet käytettävissä

- mahdolliset omat laji- tai tuntikonseptiehdotuksesi


Hakemukset lähetetään osoitteeseen toimisto@tanssittava.fi

**Haku päättyy 1.11. tai sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**

Tervetuloa mukaan Tanssittavan kasvavaan yhteisöön!

title: Tanssinopettaja, Tanssittava
description:
**Tanssittava etsii uusia tanssinopettajia joukkoonsa!**

Tanssittava on kasvava tanssistudio, joka tarjoaa laadukasta ja helposti lähestyttävää tanssinopetusta eri-ikäisille harrastajille. Toimimme useilla toimipisteillä Pirkanmaalla ja tunneillamme käy viikoittain satoja tanssijoita. Toimintaperiaatteemme perustuvat sensitiivisyyteen, ja toimintaamme ohjaavia arvoja ovat yksilöllisyys, laadukkuus sekä asiakkaidemme kokonaisvaltaisen hyvinvoinnin tukeminen.

Etsimme joukkoomme **innostavia ja luotettavia tanssinopettajia.**

Tehtävä

Tanssinopettajana suunnittelet ja toteutat omat opetustuntisi sekä vastaat ryhmäsi laadukkaasta ohjaamisesta. Opetusta on tarjolla sekä **päivä- että ilta-aikaan**.

Tarjoamme sijaistuksia ja tiiviskursseja jo heti, joten opettaminen on mahdollista aloittaa nopeastikin. Viikoittaisia opetustunteja on tarjolla tammikuusta 2027 alkaen.

Tunteja on mahdollista olla tarjolla esimerkiksi **streetissä, K-popissa ja baletista ja showtanssissa**. Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata – tärkeintä on oma vahva osaaminen ja kiinnostus opetustyöhön. Myös **muiden tanssilajien osaaminen** katsotaan eduksi.

Toivomme sinulta

- tanssialan koulutusta ja/tai vahvaa tanssitaustaa

- aikaisempaa kokemusta tanssinopetuksesta

- kykyä kohdata eri-ikäisiä ja tasoisia harrastajia

- vastuullista ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- innostavaa ja kannustavaa asennetta

- halua kehittää omaa opetustaan ja olla mukana Tanssittavan toiminnassa


**Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi**, sillä opetusta järjestetään useilla toimipisteillä Pirkanmaan seudulla. **Kerrothan hakemuksessasi, onko sinulla auto käytössä.**

Tarjoamme

- monipuolisia opetustunteja eri-ikäisille harrastajille

- mahdollisuuksia opettaa sekä **päivä- että ilta-aikaan**

- joustavuutta tuntimäärien ja opetuksen suhteen

- mahdollisuuden opettaa useilla Tanssittavan toimipisteillä Tampereen seudulla

- mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden olla mukana kasvavassa tanssistudiossa


Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä meille vapaamuotoinen hakemus, jossa kerrot lyhyesti itsestäsi, tanssitaustastasi ja opetuskokemuksestasi.

Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös:

- mitä tanssilajeja haluaisit opettaa

- millaisia ikäryhmiä haluaisit opettaa

- milloin olet käytettävissä

- **onko sinulla auto käytössä**


Hakemukset lähetetään osoitteeseen toimisto@tanssittava.fi

**Haku päättyy 1.11. tai sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**

Tervetuloa mukaan Tanssittavan kasvavaan tanssiyhteisöön!

title: Liikuntakerhon ohjaaja/seuratyöntekijä
description:
Haetaan ohjaajia alakoululaisten liikuntakerhon vetäjäksi.

Liikuntakerhot ovat alakouluilla pidettäviä kerhoja, joissa tehdään liikunnallisia leikkejä ja pelejä monipuolisesti.

Kerhoja pidetään päiväsaikaan arkisin Ylivieskan, Nivalan, Sievin, Raution ja Merijärven kouluilla.

Työhön voi sisältyä lisäksi muutamia tunteja muita seuratoimintaan liittyviä työtehtäviä.

Työtä kahdelle työntekijälle 20 h/viikossa, lisäksi neljälle työntekijälle työtä 3-6 h/viikossa.

Tehtävässä vaaditaan 18 vuoden ikää. Auton käyttömahdollisuus on välttämätön, työmatkat korvataan.

Yhteydenotot yhteystietoineen liikuntakerhokoordinaattorille: Jami Ruhkala p. 0440 568 095

Työpaikat täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

title: Kunnossapidon työntekijä
description:
Ylivieskan kaupungin kuntatekniikan palvelut vastaa kaupunkimme katujen, kevyen liikenteen väylien, muiden yleisten alueiden ympärivuotisesta kunnossapidosta ja viemäriverkoston toimivuudesta.
Teemme töitä pääsääntöisesti ulkona säällä kuin säällä, joten joustava asenne ja vaihteleviin olosuhteisiin sopeutuminen ovat meille tärkeitä. Meillä pääset tekemään konkreettista ja näkyvää työtä osana reipasta ja ammattitaitoista tiimiä. Tarjoamme monipuolisia käytännön työtehtäviä sekä vakaan ja kannustavan työyhteisön kehittyvässä kaupungissa.
Haemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen kunnossapidon työntekijää katujen, viemäreiden ja yleisten alueiden hoitoon sekä kunnossapitoon. Työtehtävät sisältävät tarvittaessa myös maanrakennustöitä (lapiotyöt/putkitus) työmailla. Työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa sekä ennen kaikkea joustavaa asennetta työntekoon.

Odotamme hakijoilta:
Ammatillista perustutkintoa (mielellään maanrakennusalan ammattitutkinto) ja/tai kokemusta maanrakennusalalta
Oma-aloitteisuutta
Rehtiä ja reipasta asennetta työtä kohtaan
Eduksi katsotaan Tieturva 1- ja työturvallisuuskortti, traktorin ajotaito sekä tasolaserin käyttötaito. Työ vaatii liikkumista koko kaupungin alueella, joten B-ajokortti on välttämätön.

Mitä tarjoamme:
Ylivieskan kaupungilla sinua odottaa itsenäinen ja vastuullinen rooli osana tiivistä työyhteisöä. Mikäli kaikki hakukriteerit eivät täyttyneetkään, mutta koet olevasi etsimämme henkilö, niin laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!
Työ alkaa: 1.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.
Työaika: 38 h 15 min / vko.
Palkkaus: 2262€/kk, Kunnallisen teknisen henkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen (TS) mukaan mahdollinen ammattialalisä

Hakemukset:
Toimitathan hakemuksesi sähköisesti 4.10.2026 klo 23:59 mennessä.

title: Combat Management System Integrator, Saab Finland, Turku/Rauma
description:
Tehtävänkuvaus

Tässä roolissa tulet osallistumaan Saabin 9LV taistelujohtojärjestelmän käyttöönottoon Raumalla vuosina 2026-2029 osana Laivue 2020 -hanketta. Combat Management System Integraattorina vastaat siitä, että Saab 9LV -taistelunjohtojärjestelmä (CMS) toimii yhtenä kokonaisuutena muiden taistelujärjestelmän (CS) alijärjestelmien, kuten sensoreiden, tutkien, luotaimien ja asejärjestelmien kanssa. Työssäsi huolehdit Saab 9LV CMS järjestelmän testausvalmiuden saavuttamisesta laivoilla yhdessä Saabin tiimin kanssa. Teet lisäksi tarvittaessa vianrajaus- ja selvitystöitä sekä integrointi-, suorituskyky- ja hyväksymistestausta. Pääset myös käyttöönottamaan järjestelmien uusia ohjelmistoversioita.

Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä Saabin testaus-, ohjelmistokehitys- ja asiakasorganisaatioiden sekä myös muiden järjestelmätoimittajien kanssa. Et ole yksin tässä roolissa vaan sinulla on vertaistukena muut CMS integraattorit niin Suomessa kuin Ruotsissa.

Työtehtävään perehtyminen tapahtuu vuoden 2026 aikana Tampereella ja Turussa. Perehtymisen aikana pääasiallinen työssäkäyntipaikkasi tulee olemaan Tampere, jossa toivomme sinun pystyvän työskentelemään noin puolet työviikosta. Turkuun suuntautuvia työmatkoja tulee olemaan arviolta joka toinen tai kolmas viikko.

Käyttöottovaiheessa pääasiallinen työssäkäyntipaikkasi tulee olemaan Rauma, jossa pääset käyttämään oppimiasi taitoja yhdessä muun Saabin käyttöönottotiimin kanssa.

Tarjoamme
- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä Suomen merkittävimmissä merivoimien modernisointihankkeissa
- Pitkäksi aikaa mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä – projektit jatkuvat vuosia
- Kansainvälisen ja teknisesti huippuluokan ympäristön
- Työn, jossa yhdistyvät ohjelmistot, sulautetut järjestelmät, verkot ja käytännön integraatiotyö

Työtehtävät
- Testausvalmiuden saavuttaminen
- Vianselvitys ja viasta palautuminen, teknisten ongelmien korjaus
- Tietojen kerääminen vikojen ja löydösten raportointia varten
- Integrointi-, kuormitus/suorituskyky- ja hyväksymistestaus
- CS/CMS-järjestelmien käyttöönotto ja integraatiotyö laivoilla ja tukikohdissa
- Yhteistyö testinsuorittajien, kehitystiimien ja kansainvälisten kollegoiden kanssa

Etsimme

- Soveltuva koulutustausta (esim. järjestelmä-, ohjelmisto- tai automaatiotekniikka)
- Kokemusta Linux komentorivin ja Dockerin käytöstä sekä tietoverkoista ja verkkolaitteista
- Valmius työskennellä konkreettisissa ympäristöissä, joissa yhdistyy ohjelmisto, laitteisto ja verkot
- Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja halu toimia asiakasrajapinnassa
- Matkustusvalmius erityisesti Raumalle ja Turkuun
- Sujuva suomi ja englanti

Arvostamme, jos sinulla on seuraavaa osaamista
- IP/Ethernet-verkot ja verkkoteknologiat
- Verkkoliikenteen analysointityökalut
- Hajautetut järjestelmät ja tietoväylät
- Tietokone- ja palvelinlaitteisto
- Git, Artifactory tai vastaava
- CI/CD-ympäristöt
- Kokemusta Jirasta tai vastaavasta tikettijärjestelmästä
- Ruotsin kielen osaaminen

Menestyäksesi roolissa olet:
- Oppimishaluinen, utelias ja aidosti kiinnostunut monimutkaisista teknisistä järjestelmistä
- Rauhallinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen myös epävarmuutta sisältävissä tilanteissa
- Oma-aloitteinen ja systemaattinen – nautit siitä, että asiat toimivat ja pysyvät hallinnassa
- Kommunikoit sujuvasti eri sidosryhmien kanssa ja viihdyt käytännönläheisessä projektityössä

Tehtävään valittavalle henkilölle teetetään turvallisuusselvitys sekä huumausainetestit.

Rekrytointiprosessimme

Academic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.

Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. Valintaprosessiin sisältyvät luonteenpiirteitä sekä kognitiivista kykyä mittaavat testit. Testit toimivat työkaluina oikean tekijän löytämiseksi tehtävään sekä takaavat tasa-arvoisen ja oikeudenmukaisen arvioinnin.

title: Sukkakoneiden mestari
description:
**Työnkuvasi:**

Sukkakoneiden mestarina pidät huolen, että neulekoneemme toimivat moitteettomasti ja tuotanto sujuu laadukkaasti.

**Tehtäviisi kuuluu normaalin tuotannon varmistamisen lisäksi mm.:**

- Neulekoneiden ennaltaehkäisevä huolto ja kunnossapito

- Mekaanisten ja sähköisten vikojen paikantaminen ja korjaus

- Koneiden hienosäätö ja asetusten tarkistaminen

- Yhteistyö neulojien ja mallimestareiden kanssa


**Mitä odotamme sinulta:**

- Mekaanista osaamista ja sähkötekniikan ymmärrystä

- Tarkkuutta ja huolellisuutta hienomekaanisten järjestelmien kanssa

- Hyviä teknisiä kädentaitoja ja perusvarmuutta tietokoneiden käytössä

- Englannin kielen perustaitoa, neulekoneiden kieli on englanti

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittää itseäsi


Koneiden rassaaminen, säätäminen ja vianetsintä tuntuvat sinusta luontevilta – nautit siitä, kun saat ratkaistua ongelman ja pidettyä tuotannon pyörimässä.

Katso sukkakoneiden mestarin, Iisan ajatukset työstä ja työnkuvasta täältä.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Vakituisen työn kasvavassa ja kansainvälisessä suomalaisyrityksessä

- Työnkuvan, jossa voit syventää osaamistasi ja kehittyä yhtiön mukana

- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen roolin, jossa kädenjäljelläsi on merkitystä

- Mukavan tiimin tuen ja työympäristön, jossa arvostetaan osaamistasi

- Monipuoliset työsuhde-edut: kattava työterveys, polkupyöräetu, liikunta- ja hierontaetu

- Työajan lyhennysvapaat (pekkaset) helpottamaan työn ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamista


**Tuntimäärä, työntekopaikka ja palkkaus:**

- Työpaikka: Tehtaamme Teivon yrityspuistossa, Ylöjärvi

- Työaika on 40 tuntia/ viikossa, keskeytyvä kolmivuorotyö (viikonloput vapaita)

- Palkka määräytyy osaamispohjasi mukaisesti

- Koeaika: 4 kk

title: IT-arkkitehti
description: IT-arkkitehtina vastaat laajojen Microsoft Active Directory -ympäristöjen arkkitehtuurista, kehittämisestä ja ylläpidosta. Tehtävässä osallistut hakemistopalveluiden jatkuvaan kehittämiseen, integraatioiden suunnitteluun sekä tietoturvallisten ratkaisujen määrittelyyn ja toteuttamiseen. Toimit asiantuntijana erilaisissa kehitys- ja muutoshankkeissa sekä teet tiivistä yhteistyötä muiden infrastruktuuri-, tietoturva- ja palveluasiantuntijoiden kanssa.

title: Automaalari, Tuusula
description:
Etsimme ammattitaitoista ja motivoitunutta automaalaria vakituiseen työhön Sulan Automaalaamolle Tuusulaan.

Työtehtäviin kuuluvat automaalausten lisäksi tarvittaessa ajoneuvojen pohjatyöt, kittaukset, korityöt sekä osien irrotus- ja asennustyöt. Arvostamme huolellista työotetta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä.

Sulan Automaalaamo on osa Suomen AutoCare Center Oy:tä, joka tarjoaa monipuolisesti autojen korjaus-, maalaus- ja autonhoitopalveluita useilla paikkakunnilla ympäri Suomen. Olemme kasvava ja vakavarainen kotimainen yritys, jossa työt tehdään laadukkaasti ja sovituista asioista pidetään kiinni.

Haemme vain OSAAVAA, KOKENUTTA, AMMATTILAISTA ja KOKEMUSTA OMAAVAA henkilöä.

Soita tai tule käymään.

title: Asiantuntijasairaanhoitaja, sisätautien poliklinikka, Vaasan keskussairaala, Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue
description:
Haemme motivoitunutta ja vastuullista kliinisen hoitotyön asiantuntijasairaanhoitajaa Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueelle. Tehtävän sijoituspaikka on aluksi Vaasan keskussairaalan sisätautien poliklinikka, kardiologia.

Meillä saat mahdollisuuden työskennellä itsenäisesti vastaanottotyössä sekä olla osa moniammatillista tiimiä, joka pyrkii tarjoamaan potilailleen parasta mahdollista palvelua ja hoitoa Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueella.

Etsimme sinua,
- jolla on kokemusta itsenäisestä työskentelystä, mutta viihdyt myös tiimityössä
- joka olet innovatiivinen ja kiinnostunut kehittämään terveydenhuollon digitalisaatiota
- jolla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja taitoa ohjata potilaita heidän terveyteensä liittyvissä käytännön ja tunne-elämän kysymyksissä
- joka olet aidosti kiinnostunut kehittymään työssäsi ja osallistumaan hoitotyön kehittämiseen
- joka olet joustava ja pystyt työskentelemään ajoittain kiireisessä ja vaativassa työympäristössä.

Tavoitteenamme on tarjota laadukasta hoitoa ja kehittää jatkuvasti toimintatapojamme vastataksemme tulevaisuuden terveydenhuollon tarpeisiin. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!


Kelpoisuusvaatimus:
Terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetussa laissa (559/1994) tarkoitettu laillistettu sairaanhoitaja SEKÄ soveltuva kliiniseen hoitotyöhön suuntautuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto TAI psykiatrialla terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetussa laissa (559/1994) tarkoitettu laillistettu sairaanhoitaja JA Lupa- ja valvontaviraston hyväksymä psykoterapeutin pätevyys TAI soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto.
Hyvä suullinen ja tyydyttävä kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä.

Valitulla tulee olla voimassa tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 § mukainen rokotussuoja.

Sovelletaan koeaikaa.

title: Data protection intern
description:
Are you a Master's student in a university or university of applied sciences and want to learn more about data protection? Are you interested in themes such as law, data protection and privacy?

We are looking for a data protection intern to join our team for three months, from October 1st 2026, to December 31st, 2026.

This internship is designed for international students eager to learn Finnish while working. Our goal is to ensure that individuals from diverse language and cultural backgrounds can smoothly work in the city, and learn the language needed in their jobs.

As a data protection intern, you will be working in the data protection team of the Education Division. We support schools, daycare centers, and other education providers in the city with both data protection and privacy related matters.

In this role, you will be working with various tasks, among other things:

- Review of privacy documentation on educational software and applications used by the Education Division
- Date requests: Handling of data requests from data subjects
- Legal case analysis: Going through legal databases and libraries to update our data protection instructions and processes
- Review sections of AI instructions intended for schools

You should have basic Finnish language skills, as the main working language is Finnish, with English used to support your tasks. We will support your Finnish language development throughout the internship and expect you to actively engage in improving your skills in everyday work situations.

You will join a team that values collaboration and mutual support as our key strengths, and we hope you share the same mindset. Our team fosters a psychologically safe environment for learning. Your workplace will be in Kalasatama, situated in our new and modern workspaces next to the metro station.

The salary for this position is 1 880,37€ per month.

Hopefully you like what you've read so far. We would love to hear from you!


Eligibility criteria:

Please note that this data protection intern position is exclusively available to students pursuing their master's degree at a university or university of applied sciences during the employment contract. Relevant fields of study include (but are not limited to) Law and Administration Studies. Previous experience in data protection and knowledge of the education sector will be considered an advantage.


To promote equality and non-discrimination, the City of Helsinki encourages anonymous recruitment, and this recruitment process will be conducted anonymously. The purpose of anonymous recruitment is to focus attention on the applicants professional competence and work experience. Please complete the job application form as usual. When writing your application, ensure that it follows the principles of anonymity. The hiring manager will select candidates for interviews based on an anonymous summary, which does not display the applicants name, age, gender, or native language.

title: Cost Engineer - Merchant, Handling
description:
**Cost Engineer - Merchant, Handling**

An exciting opportunity awaits you as Cost Engineer in our Propulsion and Handling division at Kongsberg Maritime. In this role, you will be a part of the Sales Support team in Merchant Handling business, delivering support to our external and internal customers worldwide during sales projects. The core task of our team is to understand customer requirements and expectations and turn them into solid technical and commercial proposals supporting the sales of anchoring, mooring & towing solutions.

We are looking for a proactive, structured and cooperative person to support key stakeholders in smooth execution of costing processes. You will be working closely with the Product Management, Delivery organization, Supply Chain and our Global Sales to deliver technically robust solutions to our external and internal customers worldwide.

**Key accountabilities**

- Maintain accurate cost data within our costing tools, ensuring high quality and predictability

- Actively contribute to development and continuous improvement of CPQ tools

- Act as a goto support for nonstandard and complex costings, enabling informed commercial and project decisions

- Conduct deepdive analyses into project and product cost structures to identify insights, risks, and improvement opportunities

- Collaborate closely with purchasing and production organizations, engineering, sales and project teams to support business success


**Qualifications and experience**

- Minimum of bachelors degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and understand complex product portfolios

- Fluent spoken and verbal communication skills in English

- Experience with CPQ, ERP, and PLM tools or practical experience in information system development is considered an asset

- Strong skills within Excel are considered an asset


**You are**

- Able to communicate in precise and structured way with a customer-oriented approach

- Self-driven and solution-oriented, able to make things happen and accept responsibility for the results

- Capable of fostering collaboration among stakeholders and supporting effective teamwork.

- Proactive and have a customer focused mindset

- Having a global perspective and being open to different challenges, cultures and ways of operating

- Ready to challenge yourself and develop continuously


**What we can offer you** With us, you will be offered a competitive salary, good benefit package, flexible work hours, and good development opportunities in an international environment. In accordance with the company's remote work policy, you have the possibility for partly flexible remote work. By choosing us, you get to work in an inspiring and safe work environment with sustainable and exciting solutions for the future.

**Work Location** Rauma, Finland

title: IT Service Manager, UPM, Helsinki
description:
About the role

In this role, you will provide leadership and endtoend service management ownership of global IAM, CyberSecurity and License Management within UPM IT and supplier ecosystem. You will ensure that service delivery from suppliers consistently supports business strategy, resilience, security and longterm value creation across the organization.

You will define and govern ITILbased ITSM frameworks in line with contractual requirements, setting clear expectations for service performance through SLA and KPI models while ensuring strong supplier governance and accountability. As the service manager accountable for service outcomes, you will steer prioritization, risk management and escalations, enabling transparency and informed decisionmaking at both operational and management levels, assuring compliance with; contracts and external/internal controls.

Acting as a key partner to our architectural design personnel, service owners and crossfunctional stakeholders, you will drive service alignment with enterprise roadmaps, support modernization initiatives and contribute to the evolution of scalable, futureready operating models.

Work tasks
- Provide endtoend leadership for IAM and CyberOperations services and suppliers, ensuring reliability, security and alignment with business strategy
- Establish and oversee SLA and KPI models, ensuring measurable service performance, transparency as well as continuous service improvement
- Manage service escalations and act as a single point of escalation for business-critical issues
- Lead and steer the governance forums
- Monitor service performance, risks, and dependencies across integrated services
- Drive service quality, stability, and customer satisfaction
- Ensure services comply with UPM security, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements
- Support budgeting, cost control, forecasting, and financial transparency for services
- Ensure alignment of services with UPM IT strategy, standards, and operating model
- Collaborate closely with Service Owners, Business IT, Architects and local/site IT management
- Act as the primary interface between UPM IT stakeholders and IT service providers

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of IT infrastructure, applications, and modern IT solutions
- Experience in stabilizing and improving complex IT services, specifically in IAM or CyberSecurity
- Proficiency in navigating multi-supplier ecosystems within a SIAM model
- Solid understanding of ITIL and ITSM practices
- Strong presentation, facilitation, and reporting skills
- Solution-oriented mindset with high accountability under pressure
- Fluent English skills

It is meritorious if you have
- ITIL certification

To succeed in the role, you also are:
- Change oriented
- Great communicator
- Stress tolerant

Other information:
- Start: As soon as possible
- Employment period: 6 months, possibility to extend
- Location: Helsinki, some flexibility to remote work. Occasional visits to UPM Tampere.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: IB MYP/DP Instructional Leader for Language Acquisition and Teacher
description:
The school seeks to appoint an **energetic and visionary Instructional Leader** to lead the Language Acquisition department across both the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) and Diploma Programme (DP). This role combines strategic instructional leadership with teaching responsibilities in MYP and DP Language Acquisition. This is a full-time, permanent position within our IB World School, where inquiry-driven learning, academic rigor, critical thinking, and global citizenship are at the heart of the educational experience. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping teaching and learning across the continuum, fostering innovation, and ensuring excellence in programme implementation.

**Key Instructional Leader Responsibilities**

- **Provide strategic leadership for the Language Acquisition Faculty**, setting a clear vision for excellence and curriculum development aligned with the IB continuum. In this role, you will champion our school's vision to be a community where every student is known, inspired, and challenged.

- **Drive pedagogical innovation and instructional excellence**, inspiring and empowering faculty to implement data-driven, research-informed, and student-centred practices that enhance engagement, conceptual understanding, and authentic learning.

- **Ensure coherent vertical and horizontal curriculum alignment (Grades 6–12)**, safeguarding progression, rigor, and consistency across the MYP and DP programmes.

- **Lead the monitoring and evaluation of instructional quality**, using data, classroom observation, student voice, and professional dialogue to ensure high standards of provision and continuous improvement.

- **Actively contribute to and collaborate with the team of Instructional Leaders and the Pedagogical Leadership Team**, shaping whole-school teaching and learning strategy and ensuring collective efficacy.

- **Safeguard compliance with IB Programme Standards and Practices**, ensuring programme integrity, smooth student transitions across the continuum, and a deep commitment to inclusivity and access.

- **Align faculty goals and instructional strategies with ISHs strategic vision and long-term priorities**, translating whole-school direction into impactful classroom practice.

- **Model exemplary teaching and learning practices**, demonstrating deep pedagogical knowledge and credibility as a leader of learning.

- **Lead professional growth through coaching and mentoring**, building teacher capacity, reflective practice, and instructional leadership within teams.

- **Cultivate trust-based professional relationships**, fostering collaboration, psychological safety, and a positive, high-performing school culture.

- **Promote equity, inclusion, and diversity**, ensuring that teaching practices and curriculum design reflect and value the richness of the school community.

- **Engage in ongoing professional reflection and growth**, using feedback and evidence to refine leadership impact and sustain continuous improvement.


**Key Teaching Responsibilities**

- **Teach Language Acquisition within the MYP and DP pathways**, delivering a rigorous, concept-driven curriculum aligned with IB standards. Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- **Design and implement engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences** that promote curiosity, conceptual understanding, and meaningful connections to real-world contexts.

- **Cultivate intercultural understanding, global engagement, and international-mindedness,** enabling students to explore and appreciate diverse perspectives, identities, and cultures through language learning.

- **Develop students confidence and competence as multilingual communicators,** fostering the ability to interpret, create, and exchange meaning effectively in a variety of authentic contexts.

- **Differentiate instruction effectively**, responding to diverse learning profiles, language needs, and abilities to ensure equitable access and sustained academic growth.

- **Assess student learning using IB criteria-based assessment practices**, providing timely, constructive feedback that supports reflection, goal-setting, and continuous improvement.

- **Integrate technology, interdisciplinary learning, and experiential approaches** to deepen engagement and strengthen transferable skills.

- **Collaborate actively with colleagues** to design coherent, cross-curricular learning experiences that support the holistic development of students across the IB continuum.

- **Maintain a culture of vigilance regarding student well-being**, proactively identifying changes in behaviour or engagement and reporting concerns in accordance with the schools safeguarding policies and procedures.


**Salary**

The minimum salary for the position is €3,800 - €4531.33 per month which applies to teachers with 5 years teaching experience, teaching the minimum full time hours. This includes (i) a monthly stipend of €950.10, plus (ii) salary of a full time teacher. Salary is paid according to the higher of the Private Schools collective agreement or the schools own salary scale.

**Qualifications & Experience**

- Bachelors or Masters degree in Languages, Education, or a related field.

- Teaching certification and significant (minimum 5 years) experience teaching Languages, preferably in an IB setting or international school.

- Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- Strong understanding of IB philosophy, inquiry-based learning, and global citizenship education.

- Ability to foster debate, discussion, and independent inquiry in the classroom.

- Experience with project-based learning, primary source analysis, and historical inquiry.

- Excellent communication, adaptability, and classroom management skills.

- High levels of proficiency in speaking, reading and writing in English
