title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Quick Commerce (Data Engineer)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

Deep analysis. Smarter systems. Real users. As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you'll design and maintain the data pipelines and models that power decision-making across Quick Commerce. You'll work closely with regional, business, product, data science, and analytics teams worldwide to build data solutions that drive our business and fuel new innovations.

You'll join our Analytics Engineering function within Data Foundations, working on the data model setup that powers Quick Commerce decision-making in Google Cloud, built on Apache Spark and Airflow. You'll simplify complex systems, resolve friction points, and refactor for better performance and scalability. Alongside this, you'll help shape and promote strong coding practices, and contribute to how we standardize processes across data foundations, business intelligence, data science, and analytics.

Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You'll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you'll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.

- Design and implement data pipelines, data models, and analytics solutions used across DataMesh
- Partner with cross-functional teams to define data requirements and build the data models that support them
- Build and maintain ETL processes that keep data quality and integrity high while minimizing latency and processing time
- Work with application and analytics teams to turn problem statements and metrics into efficient technical solutions
- Create dashboards that give stakeholders clear visibility into data and performance metrics across the organization
- Collaborate with data engineers on data catalogs, access controls, and governance processes, and mentor peers along the way

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, mathematics, statistics, or a related field
- 3+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics, or a related role, including experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and tools (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, SQL)
- Strong programming skills in Python, R, or Java, with proficiency in SQL
- Expertise in data modeling, database design, and data warehousing concepts, including experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL)
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Good understanding of data governance, data quality, and data security principles

Nice to have

- Master's degree in a related field
- Familiarity with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.

. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Radiation therapist needed for a 6-Month contract in Iceland
description:

    Ensure safe anesthesia and maintain patients’ vital functions throughout procedures
    Provide care and support to patients before, during, and after anesthesia
    Collaborate closely with surgeons and the multidisciplinary team
    Contribute to maintaining a high standard of patient safety and care

Qualifications

    Postgraduate qualification as a nurse anesthetist (qualification must be recognized in Scandinavia)
    Proven experience in anesthesia care
    Good English skills, both spoken and written
    Strong teamwork abilities and a patient-centered approach

Personal qualities

    Flexible and solution-oriented
    Motivated by new environments and varied working days

We offer

    Safe and well-organized working conditions
    Personal follow-up from experienced consultants
    The opportunity to combine work with new experiences abroad

Interested?

Get in touch to learn more about this opportunity, we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Prentari / Printer
description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Hæfniskröfur:
Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Um Prentmet Odda:

title: Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based (Informatiker/in)
description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based  is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

Please send your CV in English.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.- Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.- Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.- Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.- Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

Why us?
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Elementar's innovative solutions across Ireland and Northern Ireland, taking ownership of a high-potential territory and building lasting customer partnerships.

This is a remote-based role for someone passionate about scientific instrumentation, value-led selling, and developing long-term customer relationships in a technical, solution-focused environment. In this role, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting through to closing business and nurturing long-term customer relationships. You will actively develop new sales opportunities by understanding customer needs and applying our technologies to deliver value-driven solutions.

A key part of your role will be presenting both technical and commercial arguments with clarity and confidence, demonstrating how our products and services solve real-world challenges.

You will develop and execute a local business plan in partnership with the Sales Manager, ensuring alignment with growth targets and market opportunities. You'll use market insights and industry trends to identify opportunities, shape local strategy and drive continued growth across your territory, while maintaining accurate sales reporting and forecasting.

Working closely with local service and support teams & the application lab, you will deliver an outstanding customer experience from product demonstration through to after-sales support, while contributing to wider UK sales initiatives when required.

Experience, Essential Skills and Person

We are looking for someone with a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent experience) and at least 5 years’ experience in scientific instrumentation sales or a strong background in technical commercial environments. Experience working with CRM systems such as SAP would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate have a proven track record of winning new business through value-led selling and the ability to identify and convert opportunities within a technical sales environment. You will thrive in an autonomous role, balancing strategic territory development with effective pipeline management to consistently deliver results.

You will possess strong communication skills and be equally comfortable engaging with scientific specialists and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into meaningful customer value. You should be confident in negotiation, resilient in the face of challenges, and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences. A collaborative mindset, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are key to success in this role.

description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Senior Manager, EMEA Service Delivery Lead (f/m/d)  is a regional leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across all EMEA sites, serving Siemens software engineers across Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The Senior Manager directly leads EMEA SD Managers and is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, and execution of global GES programmes within the EMEA region.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Regional Leadership & Operations

- Lead and develop a regional team of SD Managers responsible for engineering support across EMEA sites.- Own regional SLO/SLA performance; ensure targets are met, tracked, and reported consistently.- Drive operational consistency across EMEA sites aligned to global GES standards and Global Operations Excellence (GOE) defined processes.- Act as the primary escalation point for EMEA service issues, customer concerns, and critical incidents.- Ensure CMDB accuracy, asset management, and monitoring compliance across EMEA sites.

Programme Delivery

- Lead EMEA execution of global transformation programmes.- Maintain regional project status, risks, and blockers; provide regular updates to the Global SD Director.- Coordinate with different stakeholders on regional deployments and platform changes.

People Leadership

- Line-manage EMEA SD Managers; set clear objectives, conduct performance reviews, and support career development.- Foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture across geographically dispersed EMEA teams.- Identify talent gaps, succession risks, and training needs within the EMEA SD function.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build strong relationships with EMEA sites stakeholders, business units, and functional managers.- Represent the EMEA region in GES global leadership forums, cross-functional reviews, and planning cycles.- Collaborate with Americas and APAC SD Leads to share best practices and drive global consistency.

Engineering Segment Engagement

- Execute the GES engineering segment engagement model within EMEA; act as the regional point of contact for EMEA segment leads on infrastructure quality, environment needs, and development productivity.- Establish a structured engagement cadence with EMEA engineering segment representatives to gather feedback on CI/CD environments, tooling gaps, and productivity blockers.- Identify and escalate EMEA-specific development environment constraints that impact engineering velocity; collaborate with GOE and Architecture & Standards to drive resolution.- Contribute regional segment insights to GES-wide reporting on developer productivity and service quality.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Substantial relevant experience in service delivery, infrastructure operations, or engineering support, with a demonstrated track record of regional management responsibility across multiple countries.- Proven experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple countries within the EMEA region.- Strong working knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and service level management practices.- Experience managing escalations, service performance, and operational governance in a complex enterprise environment.- Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional programmes and change within large, matrixed organizations.- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English (additional language proficiency is an advantage).- Solid understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle tracking, and software asset inventory across distributed sites.- Practical knowledge of data center operations, including RDC/colocation environments, physical infrastructure management, and capacity oversight.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup frameworks sufficient to manage and govern SD teams responsible for these environments.- Awareness of vulnerability management practices, including coordination with security teams on remediation tracking and compliance obligations across EMEA sites.- Familiarity with software development practices and the SDLC; ability to engage with engineering teams on environment needs and tooling requirements without deep hands-on development experience.- Awareness of CI/CD concepts and pipeline dependencies; sufficient understanding to identify where GES infrastructure is a bottleneck or enabler for engineering delivery.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering or large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments.- Hands-on or supervisory experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack or equivalent platforms).- Exposure to high-performance or grid computing environments — understanding of compute cluster operations, job scheduling, and distributed infrastructure management.- Understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery across EMEA.- Experience managing EMEA-specific regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., data residency, works council processes, GDPR implications for IT operations).- Exposure to software engineering or DevOps environments — direct collaboration with development teams or platform engineering; comfort discussing developer workflow tooling, build pipelines, and environment provisioning.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required at minimum; Managing Professional track highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation — IT governance and control framework awareness.- ISO 27001 awareness — relevant to EMEA regulatory and security compliance considerations.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Foundation or Practitioner.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This role is based in EMEA, with a preference for one of Siemens' DISW established locations.
Regular travel across EMEA sites is expected.

Part of: GES Global Service Delivery function, GTI

Strategic Leadership

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

description:

Job Title: Social Care Worker Reporting to: Social Care Leader, Social Care Manager & Service Manager. Purpose: To provide high-quality care to young people resident in Pathways Ireland and support the management team in delivering a safe, stable, caring and therapeutic service. Key Duties: • Provide high-quality care and uphold the rights, dignity and welfare of young people. • Contribute to a safe, stable, caring and therapeutic environment. • Support the implementation and development of care plans and programmes of care. • Promote young people’s physical, emotional, educational, social and recreational development. • Develop personal, interpersonal, social and problem-solving skills. • Plan and participate in appropriate activities and supervise outings. • Support young people to participate actively in their own care and engage appropriately within community/family settings. • Complete required activity risk assessments in line with company policy. • Maintain accurate files, records and reports, including documentation for reviews and case conferences. • Report accidents, incidents, complaints, allegations and relevant developments to management. • Work collaboratively with colleagues and attend meetings, supervision, training and induction. • Follow organisational policies, procedures and health & safety requirements. • Contribute to hygiene, cleanliness and the effective running of the centre. • Promote positive links with families, schools, community organisations, local services and An Garda Síochána. • Administer and accurately account for centre monies. • Support adequate staffing levels and undertake other duties as directed. • Supervise social care students on placement. • Adhere to the CORU Code of Professional Conduct and Ethics, maintain CORU registration and complete CPD as required. Essential Qualifications: Applicants must be registered with the CORU Social Care Workers Registration Board, or have applied through a Section 91 application and be awaiting registration. Relevant approved Social Care qualifications include BA/B.A. (Hons) awards in Social Care, Applied Social Care, Social Care Practice, Professional Social Care Practice, Social Care Work or Applied Social Studies in Social Care. Skills & Competencies: Knowledge of child development, behaviour management, attachment, leadership and childcare legislation. Strong communication, interpersonal, reflective practice and report-writing skills. Ability to work independently and within a team, support colleagues, build positive relationships with young people and remain calm in crisis situations. Other Requirements: Flexibility and willingness to work shifts, weekends and unsocial hours. Computer, counselling, recreation and report-writing skills required. This job description outlines the general duties of the post and is subject to periodic review.

title: Residential Care Worker
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs. No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs. You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism. Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard. Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment. Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing. Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures. Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling. Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care. Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed. Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery. Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team. Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members. Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers. Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans. Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures. Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

description:

Job Title: Residential Care Worker Reporting to: Social Care Leader, Social Care Manager and Service Manager. Purpose: To provide high-quality care to young people resident in Pathways Ireland and support the management team in the delivery of a safe, stable and therapeutic service. Key Duties and Responsibilities: •Work as part of a team to provide high-quality care and support to young people. •Promote and uphold the rights, dignity, welfare and best interests of young people. •Contribute to a safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment. •Support the implementation and development of care plans and programmes of care. •Support young people’s physical, emotional, educational, social and recreational development. •Develop young people’s personal, interpersonal, social and problem-solving skills. •Plan and participate in suitable recreational, community and educational activities and supervise outings. •Facilitate young people to participate actively in their own care. •Engage appropriately with young people in community and family settings. •Complete required risk assessments for activities in line with company policy. •Maintain accurate and confidential records, files and reports, including reports for reviews and case conferences. •Report accidents, incidents, complaints, allegations and other relevant developments to management and complete required documentation. •Work collaboratively with colleagues and support the effective delivery of care. •Attend staff meetings, supervision, training and induction as required. •Follow all organisational policies, procedures and health and safety requirements. •Contribute to maintaining high standards of hygiene, cleanliness and safety within the centre. •Promote positive links with families, schools, community organisations, local services and An Garda Síochána. •Administer and accurately account for centre monies. •Support adequate staffing levels and carry out other duties as directed by the Centre Manager. Essential Qualifications: Applicants must hold one of the following: QQI Level 7 in Psychology, Youth & Community, Social Science/Studies, Family Support, Disability Studies, Applied Behavioural Analysis or Early Years Care; QQI Level 7/professional qualification in Child & Adolescent Psychotherapy, Counselling/Psychotherapy or Addiction Counselling; professional qualification in Teaching (excluding TEFL) or Nursing Studies; BA in Applied Policing or equivalent; or Higher Certificate in Custodial Care (Irish Prison Service) or equivalent. Skills and Competencies: Knowledge of child development, behaviour management, attachment, leadership and childcare legislation. Strong communication, interpersonal, reflective practice and report-writing skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team, remain calm in crisis situations, support colleagues and build positive relationships with young people. Computer, counselling and recreational skills required.

title: Healthcare Assistant – Community Home Care
description:

Nightingale Health & Homecare Providers Ltd. is recruiting a full-time Healthcare Assistant to provide professional home care and personal support to clients in their own homes across Cork City and surrounding suburbs. The successful applicant will provide person-centred care in accordance with individual care plans and company policies. Main duties include assisting clients with personal hygiene, dressing, grooming, toileting, continence care, mobility and transfers. The role also includes assistance with meals, hydration, companionship, social support and activities of daily living while promoting dignity, independence and choice. The Healthcare Assistant will support older people and clients with dementia, reduced mobility or other care needs. They will observe clients' general wellbeing and report any concerns or changes in condition to the appropriate member of the care management team. Other duties include maintaining accurate care records, following infection prevention and control procedures, safeguarding clients, maintaining confidentiality and communicating appropriately with clients, families and healthcare professionals. Applicants should hold a QQI Level 5 qualification in Healthcare Support or an equivalent recognised health or social care qualification and have relevant healthcare or home care experience. Good spoken and written English, effective communication skills, reliability and the ability to work independently and as part of a care team are required. Applicants must be flexible to work rostered shifts, including some evenings, weekends and Bank Holidays where required. A full Category B driving licence and access to transport are desirable where travel between clients is required. Successful applicants will be subject to Garda Vetting, reference checks and verification of qualifications. Permanent full-time position, 39 hours per week. Minimum annual remuneration is €33,462 based on a basic rate of €16.50 per hour. Enhanced rates may apply for eligible weekend, Sunday and Bank Holiday shifts. Location of employment is Cork City and surrounding Cork suburbs, with care provided primarily in clients' own homes. Nightingale Health & Homecare Providers Ltd. is an equal opportunities employer.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich

- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Gi Group, in partnership con E.D Elettronica Dedicata, azienda specializzata nella progettazione e produzione di sistemi elettronici embedded per vari settori, e CNOS-FAP Lombardia, cerca persone motivate a iniziare un nuovo percorso lavorativo-formativo (IFTS) di ITS Lombardia Meccatronica presso i Salesiani di Brescia. Il percorso è rivolto a candidati/e di età compresa tra 18-24 anni in possesso di almeno uno dei seguenti requisiti: - Diploma di Istruzione Secondaria Superiore; - Diploma professionale conseguito in esito ai percorsi quadriennali di IeFP; - Ammissione alla V annualità dei percorsi liceali. Si offre inserimento con contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello in somministrazione. CCNL applicato: Metalmeccanico Artigianato Livello di inquadramento: 3 Retribuzione prevista: la retribuzione prevista è pari a 5,07 €/h per formazione interna e 7,10 €/h per ore lavoro. Non perdere quest'opportunità e iniziare a fare la differenza nel settore elettronico. Il candidato ideale possiede un approccio strutturato e metodico. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, principalmente scritta, per la gestione di documentazione tecnica internazionale e per il contatto con i fornitori stranieri Condizioni di inserimento: Stage di 6 mesi Extracurriculare, rimborso di 650€ Orario di lavoro: Full time 40h settimanali dal lunedì al venerdì orario su giornata Sede: Trezzano SN *Grafton Office è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:
Your qualifications
•    Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Metallurgy or Mining
•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange in Stockholm and has a secondary listing on the NASDAQ OMX in Helsinki. www.ssab.com

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d) f. Liechtenstein gesucht A26/9821 Li (Hausdame/Housekeeper)
description:
Liechtenstein

Gesucht wird für einen gehobenen 2-Personen-Privathaushalt in einem stilvollen kleinen Familienschloss in Liechtenstein eine erfahrene und engagierte **Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d).** Die private Residenz umfasst rund 15 Zimmer sowie ein parkähnliches Grundstück. Sie arbeiten in einem gepflegten, repräsentativen Umfeld gemeinsam mit weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses und übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit hoher Eigenständigkeit.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Verantwortungsvolle Führung und Organisation des gehobenen Privathaushalts
- Sicherstellung einer tadellosen Sauberkeit, Ordnung und gepflegten Atmosphäre im gesamten Haus
- Reinigung und Pflege hochwertiger Oberflächen, Materialien und Einrichtungen
- Fachgerechte Wäschepflege, einschließlich Waschen, Bügeln, Falten und Versorgen anspruchsvoller Textilien
- Sicherer und sorgfältiger Umgang mit hochwertigen Stoffen, Antiquitäten, Kunstgegenständen und wertvollem Inventar
- Vorbereitung und Zubereitung kleiner Mahlzeiten, insbesondere des Frühstücks
- Aufmerksame Betreuung der Hausherren sowie professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Gästen
- Unterstützung bei Empfängen, Einladungen und besonderen Anlässen
- Koordination und Abstimmung mit den weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses
- Konsequente Einhaltung und Kontrolle der geltenden Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards

Ihr Profil

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Hausdame, Gouvernante oder in einer vergleichbaren Position in einem gehobenen Privathaushalt
- Fundierte Vorkenntnisse aus der 4- oder 5-Sterne-Hotellerie
- Ausgeprägte Gastgeberqualität, Serviceorientierung und ein sicheres, kultiviertes Auftreten
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Pflege hochwertiger Wäsche und Textilien
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit Antiquitäten, Kunstobjekten und anspruchsvoller Einrichtung
- Selbstständige, strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Diskretion und Loyalität
- Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit in einem privaten, exklusiven Umfeld
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gepflegte Erscheinung und ausgezeichnete Umgangsformen
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Arbeitszeiten am Wochenende
- Ausgezeichneter Leumund

Geboten wird

- Eine verantwortungsvolle und langfristig ausgerichtete Position in einem außergewöhnlichen privaten Umfeld
- Ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima in einem professionell geführten Haushalt
- Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden in Haus und Garten
- Eine vielseitige, anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
- Ein überdurchschnittliches Gehalt, welches sich an Erfahrung und Qualifikation orientiert

Bei der Wohnungssuche ist die Familie gerne behilflich, es handelt sich hier um eine Vollzeit-Anstellung. Gebeten wird um vollständige Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Lebenslauf, Referenzen und Angaben zu Ihrer Verfügbarkeit. Die Position ist nach Absprache zu besetzen und wird ausnehmend gut vergütet.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. • Adhere to Pictet Group and PAS Risk and Compliance policies.
